GENERATE BURST VF-prim-poison-puff-01 — painted primitive S-poison LOBED DENSITY PUFF — the body of a poison cloud (a DENSITY asset: coverage and density are validated separately) for the POISON treatment (Run C-5, E3; architecture 03- § 2.3 build list). task_id "VF-prim-poison-puff-01". One primitive per call. Paint the SHAPE REPRESENTING EMISSION only — light, glow, colour and motion are runtime layers.

IMAGE 1 is the SCALE + REGISTER board: a 1:1 native 512×512 crop of the painted cliffside clearing at the game camera with two figures 130 px tall (= 1 BH) beside a 3× enlargement; everything is hand-drawn painted 2D — confident dark contour with taper, clean painted planes, restrained texture. IMAGE 2 is the APPROVED FIRE impact peak: the LANGUAGE to match (four flat greyscale planes, hard plane edges, hand-drawn contour, no gradients or glow) — not the shape. Poison speaks the same language with its own vocabulary: viscous, heavy, drooping — lobes and drips with rounded sagging edges, bubbles as small closed contours; nothing sharp, nothing flickering. IMAGE 3 is the native ground crop alone (reading only).

Deliver EXACTLY ONE image, 512×512, GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background (RGBA: alpha 0 outside the body, opaque inside, no soft fringe wider than 1 px) — if transparency is impossible, a flat uniform #00ff00 plate and SAY SO. Content: a LOBED DENSITY PUFF of poison gas: a bounded cloud built from five or six overlapping rounded lobes of unequal size, heavier and denser at the bottom (plane 1) and lighter at the top (planes 2–3 as the thinnest lobes), the outline made of sagging arcs; asymmetric; hand-drawn dark contour with taper. PAINTED EXTENT: about 200 px across (1.55 BH) and 150 px tall; centred; nothing touches the canvas edge. Same camera as IMAGE 1. VALUE-INDEX ENCODING: GREYSCALE ONLY, exactly FOUR flat value planes with hard edges (plane 0 near-black = contour + thin rim; plane 1 dark grey; plane 2 light grey, most of the body; plane 3 white = the brightest core/edges, no more than a quarter of the body), no gradients, glow, blur, texture or colour. One frame of hand-drawn 2D effects animation at the scene's line weight. No ground, shadow, sparkles, mist, motion blur, character or text.

One image_gen call. ONE retry only if: the background is not clean, there are gradients/glow/soft edges or more than four value planes, the body touches the canvas edge, the extent is off by more than 25 %, or the vocabulary is wrong — name the reason. Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/poison_puff_01.png with sha256 (no conversion, no trim, no keying). No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "VF-prim-poison-puff-01"): files = [exactly one entry: out/poison_puff_01.png with its sha256]; images = the INTEGER COUNT of image_gen calls made (1 or 2) — NOT a list, NEVER a path under $CODEX_HOME/generated_images; calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS with concerns listed honestly (state whether the output has real transparency).
